reusable_now.item: Custom GDS backend and hierarchy export experience
reusable_now.reason: Existing gds_writer.py and gds_hierarchy_export.py already solve project-local serialization and import concerns.

reusable_now.item: Module metadata and generator manifest framework
reusable_now.reason: Module inventories, manifests, bbox, pin, and rail metadata are directly useful to the new registry layer.
Existing JSON/MD report patterns and sanity checks can host R3/R4 audits.
Later validation evidence can still reuse the current external DRC marker analysis flow.
R1 is the authoritative semantic/physical contract for the new generator front end.

adaptable.reason: Reuse registry conventions and standalone metadata, but not as the full SRAM generator.
Selected GDS import and output helpers are reusable after removing candidate-only placement assumptions.
Structural checks and report formatting are reusable as generator-stage validation hooks.
Primitive routing and pin-export concepts are informative, but implementation remains self-developed.

do_not_reuse_or_extend.reason: Legacy candidate output is evidence only; it is not the new generator substrate.
The new floorplanner must be array-centric and generator-owned.
R3/R4 need route- and geometry-backed ownership, not only contract edges.

do_not_reuse_or_extend.item: patching top_level_assembly into full SRAM generator
do_not_reuse_or_extend.reason: That path would preserve the wrong abstraction boundary and technical debt.
The new flow should remain local, explicit, and intent-driven.
OpenYield should keep backend serialization separate from generator composition logic.
Current supported scope is intentionally single-bank and single-port.
